intro.title: Welcome to Kind
intro.body: Before you start exploring, we'll walk through how Kind works and ask for your consent — one clear choice at a time. Each consent is separate, never pre-ticked, and you can change it later in your profile.
intro.metaNote: This is research and self-experimentation, not medical care, and it is voluntary.

exploration.name: Do morning rules reduce my chances of an afternoon crash?

atAGlance.label: The change you'll make
atAGlance.value: Follow your morning rules — early light, stretch, delayed caffeine, meditation

atAGlance.label: Data used
atAGlance.value: Your daily ratings + logged morning rules

steps.title: Welcome & platform consent
steps.body: Kind lets you run small, structured "health explorations" on yourself — testing whether a change you make affects an outcome you care about. You're your own comparison, and you'll get a personalised read-out. This is research and self-experimentation, not medical care, and it is voluntary.
steps.body2: Over time we'll offer you specific explorations to join. With your permission, we also study combined, de-identified results to learn what works and for whom, and share findings as research publications.
steps.footnote: Research field: lifestyle and behaviour-change effects on everyday health outcomes. You can read the full Participant Information Sheet before deciding.
steps.withdrawNote: You can withdraw at any time in Settings. Withdrawing stops future use of your data; results already combined into a published, de-identified dataset can't be pulled back out.

consents.label: I agree to take part in the Kind platform and to the use of my data as described in the Participant Information Sheet.

steps.title: Join your first exploration
steps.body: You're about to start your morning rules exploration. Here's what it involves at a glance.

consents.label: I want to join this exploration and consent to the use of my data for my personalised (N-of-1) analysis.

steps.title: Optional sharing choices
steps.body: These are optional. Your personalised results don't depend on them, and you can change them anytime.

consents.label: Use my de-identified data in combined research about how this and other explorations work.
consents.sub: Supports research publications (pre-prints). Your data is de-identified before this use.

consents.label: Let me share my own individual results with people I choose.
consents.sub: Turns on a share feature for your personal read-out. You control who sees it.

steps.title: Consumer health data
steps.body: Because you're in New York / your state, we ask for separate, opt-in permission for your health data, kept apart from our terms of service.
steps.footnote: We do not sell your consumer health data. You can withdraw consent, access your data, or delete it anytime — see the Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy.

consents.label: I consent to Kind COLLECTING my consumer health data for the purposes described in the Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy.
I consent to Kind SHARING my consumer health data as described in that policy (separate from collection).

complete.title: You're ready to explore
complete.body: Thanks, Anna. Your choices are saved and you're in control. You can review or change any of them anytime from your profile.

summary.title: My consent & data sharing
summary.body: These are the consents you gave during onboarding. Each is separate and you can change it at any time.
summary.notStartedBody: Run the onboarding and consent process to set your choices. Until then, this shows the defaults on Anna's demo profile.
summary.withdrawNote: You're in control. You can leave an exploration, withdraw from research use of future data, turn off result-sharing, or delete your account at any time. Anything already combined into a published, de-identified dataset cannot be extracted.
